data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $75,625,000 (2021: $60,654,000) is a deterioration of $10,434,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2021: deterioration $5,306,000).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross strengthening of $25.471 million in prior year reserves, primarily affecting the 2019 and 2020 years of account. This deterioration was influenced by the syndicate's reserving methodology, which incorporated additional information from pricing and prospective business, as well as a loading for inflation and a margin above actuarial best estimates. Changes in estimates of IBNR claims and developments in case reserving for attritional and large losses also contributed to the adverse development.
raw_causal_phrases: back year deterioration on the 2020 and prior years of account on a stand-alone basis
loading for inflation and a margin added over and above actuarial best estimates
assumptions underlying our reserving methodology reflect additional information obtained from pricing current and prospective business
developments in case reserving for attritional losses, large losses, or from changes in estimates of IBNR claims
profit declared on the 2020 year of account, which is lower than planned
data.data_quality_notes: The report contains conflicting statements regarding net prior year development. Page 4 states a net profit of $5.0m on 2021 and prior years (implying a release), while page 24 states a net deterioration of $10.434m in claims reserves for prior years (implying a strengthening). The gross prior year development of +25.471m is calculated from the gross claims development triangle on page 22, which is the preferred source for gross figures.
